d: Bihar ki rajniti men disanbar ka mahina do bahubliyon ke lie aham hone vala hai. JDU se jure Anant Singh ko 4 disanbar ko sarendar karna hai, vahin purv sansad Anand Mohan ki rihaee radd karte hue Supreme Court ne unhen ek mahine ke andar sarendar karne ka aadesh diya hai. donon netaon ke mamlon ko lekar bihar ki siyasat men charcha tej hai.
